Hands-on experience eliciting, analyzing and documenting requirements, including user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and functional requirements. Experience defining product priorities, maintaining a backlog and supporting digital solutions through discovery, delivery, testing, launch and improvement. Experience supporting AI-enabled or conversational solutions, and fluency in using AI tools in your own analysis and documentation work. Stakeholders and Delivery Experience acting as the link between business stakeholders and technology delivery teams, managing multiple stakeholders, workstreams and competing priorities in a complex or matrixed organization.
